name: c3_cross_hopstep_pre_cinderella_post
description: Negative control for the candidate. The second clip is a different character whose own factors are an enhanced form of the first record's parent1 factors, so the two are related by inheritance and not by enhancement: no candidate may be offered, while the resolver links the existing child's parent1 to the new record across the enhancement. The link is read from the child's raw record.json; the child also gains relation_bonus 0 (one linked parent, no grandparent), which is why its golden record carries it.
